title: Arma Reforger 1.7 and a fresh start
line: A tile inventory, vehicle garages, temperature, blood and sickness, key bunkers, a moving oil rig and carrier, Land Rovers, the MH-6, convoys.

title: New hardware
line: EU and NA moved to faster machines.

title: Building rebuilt
line: A build menu, triangle foundations, garage doors, upgrade paths, every kit salvageable, free placement. Supply drops, abandoned bases, heli crashes you shoot down.

title: A wipe schedule
line: Every six weeks, decided with the community. Chernarus servers at 100 slots.

title: Chernarus fixed for PS5
line: The northern crash fixed, and a performance gain for everyone.

title: The big update
line: Fishing, the inventory back, daily and weekly quests, stock-based traders with weapon tiers, vehicle batteries, base electricity, code locks, animals, harder zombies, a lockpick minigame, a fuel economy, and Faircroft Island as the second map.

title: Stacks, trading and arcades
line: Stackable items and faster inventories, item cards that say where to sell, full price on big sales, two arcade machines with weekly prizes.

title: Bases and cooking
line: Code locks on tents and sheds, window walls you can shoot from, C4 against locks, bigger generator tanks, cooking at base fireplaces.

title: The first Town Hall
line: A community meeting on the Discord stage, and a Community Board.
